summary: XCHG Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing receipt of a September 8, 2026 Nasdaq letter confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The ADS closing bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days, August 24 to September 4, 2026, closing the June 24, 2026 deficiency notice ahead of the December 21, 2026 cure deadline. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated. The filing updates the F-3 and S-8 registration statements. This is a routine listing-compliance disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
